_what: Browser routes under /work/api that this process answers through an owner it mounts, each as one <family>:request operation carrying its path, method and body (src/workspace_domain.rs OwnerRoutes). Every row names an owner the native workspace executor mounts (src/local_workspace.rs read_input), and a test resolves every row against it. A row with `rest` true carries, for a path one of its prefixes admits, the rest of the path after that prefix as it was asked (its input's `rest`): the generic screen host's row answers GET /work/api/screens (the catalogue) and GET /work/api/screens/<id> (one screen of it, src/tool_runs/page_routes.rs, the old application src/screen-host.mjs) by it. The rows of src/server/tool-routes.json, each a page route answered by running one Workshop tool, are matched before every row here. A request no row and no fixed route names gets one final answer: 404 with failure_code no-owner. A row with `browser` true carries the asking browser's own facts with its command (its User-Agent, the origin it asked at and its visitor mark), and nothing else of the browser. The row whose family is the records door's resource (src/record_value/records-routes.json `resource`) is the page's road to that door's generic records read: GET /work/api/door/<operation>?input=<JSON> runs the door's read, list or history operation (src/record_value/account_routes.rs Door::page_call) under the page's own session, the same read an AI's key reaches over MCP. The row whose family is the Workshop's address (src/tool_runs/tools/tool-runs.json `address`) is the page's road to that owner's `page_operations` (src/tool_runs/tools.rs Workshop::page_call): GET /work/api/door/<list>?input=<JSON> and POST /work/api/door/<run> with body {tool, input}, a run only with its own request key; it is listed before the records door's row so its GET is its own. The row whose family is the account files door's resource (src/account_files/account-files-door.json `resource`) is the page's road to that door's operations (src/account_files/account_routes.rs AccountFilesDoor::page_call): GET /work/api/files/<operation>?input=<JSON> for the door's page reads and POST /work/api/files/<operation> with the input as body for the rest, under the page's own session, the same call an AI's key makes at that door.
